title: Proclamation Of 1858
definition: The Queen's Proclamation of 1858, issued on November 1, 1858, by Queen Victoria, transferred the governance of India directly from the British East India Company to the British Crown, signaling a major paradigm shift in Indian administrative history.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (historical chronology, constitutional milestones, transfer of power) and Mains GS-1 (British administrative policies post-1857, evolution of civil services, policy of 'divide and rule', and treatment of princely states).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Proclamation Of 1858.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
